correctness.rationale: On a 5-set there are exactly ten hypotheses (unique smaller 2-subsets). All 3-edge query supports have one of four graph types: triangle, 3-star, 4-path, 3-path plus disjoint edge; each admits a forbidden answer pattern, while two adjacent edges shatter, proving VC=2. The displayed adaptive query tree has eight witness leaves, giving Ldim≥3, and log2(10)<4 bounds Ldim≤3. Direct independent recursion over all concepts for n=2..5 reproduced every profile pair (VC,Ldim): (0,0),(1,1),(2,2),(1,1),(2,2),(2,3) in listed order. For s independent known groups, VC and realizable Ldim add across disjoint nonconstant query domains; cross-group tests are constant false. Hence exactly (2s,3s), with no finite extrapolation.
residual_risks: Five-point class is unlabeled within blocks; treating 2- and 3-block as ordered would be incorrect.
No formula for unprescribed global partitions of 5s vertices.

value.rationale: Minimal local example of a strict static-vs-adaptive shattering gap for natural fixed-size equivalence relations. The all-s product family has a quantitatively unbounded gap while every interacting group stays of fixed size five; this pinpoints a structural failure of nonadaptive shattering to capture online complexity in a constrained clustering concept class.
residual_risks: Amplification is by independent prescribed blocks, not arbitrary global balanced cuts.
